description: C2: a crumbling tower of the old kings' toll-keep, the walls the Broken Warden wore, split and leaning. Tagged rubble: brought down within his record's rubble.radius_m (a giant's blows, a stage-6 giant walking into it, his own wall charge) it falls on him - he staggers, his guard is open and every blow rocks him more for a while (TitanEnemy.rubble_fall). One use: it stays down.
